summary: Recommends ₹50,000-crore BioEconomy Growth Fund across 6 National BioMissions.

blocks.content: Recommends ₹50,000-crore BioEconomy Growth Fund across 6 National BioMissions.

items: Bioeconomy Targets: Projects growth from .3B (2025) to  by 2035 and .6 trillion by 2047 (8-10% of  GDP).
6 National BioMissions: GeneIndia, AgriBio 2.0, BioX Foundry, One Health Grid, Marine Biotechnology, BioPharmaNext.
Fund Allocation: Proposes ₹50,000-crore BioEconomy Growth Fund (2026-2035) to bridge lab-to-market commercialisation.
